title: Supported exterior products are natural in normalized support maps
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, f:X→S and g:Y→S morphisms of schemes, and b,bprime closed immersions into X and d,dprime closed immersions into Y. Write P=X×_S Y and i,i prime for the respective product supports [def-pur-supported-localization-comparisons]. Let r1:Γ_b→Γ_bprime, r2:Γ_d→Γ_dprime, and r0:Γ_i→Γ_iprime be natural transformations of ordinary supported sections. Assume each composite with the canonical inclusion into ordinary global sections is the source inclusion. For every K∈D(X_et,A), L∈D(Y_et,A), the supported exterior products [def-pur-supported-exterior-product] satisfy κ_(b,d) R(r0)=(R(r1)⊗R(r2))κ_(bprime,dprime). No finite type or boundedness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tags 09XP, 095L and 0F1E; supported sections and the evaluation-normalized supported pairing.

proof.text: Conjugate each support map under the normalized supported coefficient adjunction. Transposition and the inclusion normalization imply that each coefficient map preserves its constant quotient.

Cancel the epic product constant quotient. The ordinary coefficient tensor normalization and the two projected quotient normalizations prove its naturality square. Apply derived tensor comparison naturality.
The derived conjugate counit identity follows by right-derived uniqueness and its ordinary degreewise version. Exact functor composition then identifies the projected evaluations.
Transpose the derived coefficient tensor square and compose it with the two evaluation squares. Bifunctor naturality gives the asserted equality. Keep the native scheme tensor explicit throughout.
